What Needs You
Search How This Works
Search
What Needs You
Show Everything

What Needs You is where the world tells you things and asks you things. A notice says what happened: groceries you couldn’t pay for, a commitment you slept through, a welcome to the school. A question carries its answers as buttons, such as File It or Keep The Account, and Dismiss. The number beside Home on the menu is how many of both are waiting.

Where To Find It
Home, The What Needs You Panel.
When You Can Use It
From “What Needs You”.
Show Me Where
What To Press
Open Home and read What Needs You: questions first, then notices.
Press one of a question’s answers to act on it there. It does what the same button on its own screen does.
Press Go There to open the screen a question or a notice is about.
Press Dismiss to take a question off the list without answering it.
Press Mark N Read, at the top of the panel, to mark every unread notice read at once.
Press Show All N, under the notices, to see every unread one before you do: the panel draws the six most important first, and Show The Six Most Important goes back to them.
Press a question’s or a notice’s title to open it: how urgent or important it is, when it closes, and where it sits in the list.

How This Works

RBC Signature No Limit Banking at RBC Royal Bank, C$26,489. This is your primary account.

Your wages and other payments are paid into it. Your everyday card’s autopay pays from it.

Your primary account is the one money comes from unless you say otherwise: your debit card’s everyday purchases come from it; cash from a machine comes out of it; bills you pay by hand come from it; a new standing order or autopay starts from it. Making another account primary doesn’t move anything already set up.

How This Works

Your wages and other payments go to RBC Signature No Limit Banking. A change reaches Yale’s payroll in 7 days, about one of its weekly pay cycles, as Yale says. Other payers take 14 days, which is estimated: employers say one to two pay cycles.

How This Works
Open An Account At Another Bank
How This Works

There’s no switching service here. To move banks, open the new account, have your wages paid into it, move each standing order and autopay, move the money across, and then close the old account. The new account starts empty, with its own history.

How This Works

Rewards: 2% on groceries to the first C$6,000 a year, 1% after; 0.5% on everything else to the first C$6,000 a year, 1% after, added up at each statement. You have C$0 to redeem. RBC cancels a lost or stolen debit card and issues a new one, and blocks a lost or stolen credit card from further use and issues a new card. The first debit card replacement in a calendar year is free and each further one costs $5.00, unless the replacement is due to fraud, a name change, or a card that arrived damaged.

RBC texts the credit cardholder from short code 722373 or 347722 asking them to reply Y to confirm a transaction or N if they don't recognize it, after which a fraud specialist contacts them. The card agreement says RBC can block the card without telling the customer when it suspects fraudulent use.

The law on the debit card: Debit cards fall under the voluntary Canadian Code of Practice for Consumer Debit Card Services (section 5): the cardholder isn't liable for losses from circumstances beyond their control, including being the victim of fraud, theft or coercion, technical failures, and use after the card is reported lost or stolen. A cardholder who contributed (for example by voluntarily sharing a PIN or not reporting in reasonable time) can be liable, but no more than the card's withdrawal limits, and more only where overdraft or a linked credit line is attached. There’s no statutory dollar cap for debit.

The law on the credit card: Bank Act, S.C. 1991, c. 46, s. 627.33: a borrower's maximum liability for unauthorized use of a credit card issued in Canada is $50 unless they showed gross negligence (gross fault in Quebec), and nothing after they report the card lost, stolen or at risk. Use of the PIN alone doesn't prove gross negligence. For non-bank federally regulated issuers, FCAC says the cap is the lesser of $50 or the agreement's amount.

The law on a payment you report as not yours: Debit Card Code of Practice: the issuer must respond to a report of an unauthorized transaction as soon as possible and in no more than 10 business days, a limit it can pause while waiting for a signed statement or affidavit. No statutory refund deadline is set for credit cards.

How This Works

Unemployment is paid in the game only in New York, California and Connecticut, and you’d have to live in one of them.

Each Sunday the week is certified for you, from anywhere in the country, as an interstate claim is. A week abroad pays nothing, and neither does a week while you’re a full-time student in Connecticut. A week with work pays a share of the benefit by the hours worked, and nothing once the pay reaches the maximum, counting the wages paid that week. Work-study wages come from your school and don’t count in the claim’s base period. What’s paid is taxable income on your return.

How This Works

OPT gives you up to twelve months to work in your field, from the later of your program’s end and the approval, with no more than 90 days without work in total. The game has no work after the degree, so an approved OPT ends after its 90 days without work, and your US status ends with it. In practice it keeps you in the US about 90 days from its start. It costs C$643.90. Premium processing adds C$2,438.60 and gets a decision within 30 business days.
